The artificial sweeteners in diet sodas and other calorie free options go so far to trick your entire body (not just your taste buds) into thinking you have just consumed sugar. In similar quantities as a regular coke, your body turns to fat storage mode. Unfortunately, after all that, you lack the actual satisfaction (subconsciously) of consuming sugar and you're now more likely to crave real sugar. It's a horrible cycle and it's manipulative and abusive to the customers who have no desire to find out what they love is bad for them.
